helpText: Schengen C Business visas permit client meetings, consultations, and trade exhibitions, but strictly forbid local productive labor.

questionText: What is the planned total duration of your stay in the Schengen area (in days)?
helpText: Short-stay Schengen business visas allow a maximum stay of 90 days within any 180-day rolling window.
flagTriggerRule: {"field":"value","operator":"greaterThan","operand":90,"flag":{"code":"FLAG_EXCESSIVE_DURATION_SCHENGEN","severity":"CRITICAL","message":"Requested stay exceeds 90 days. Short-stay Schengen visas are strictly capped at 90 days per 180-day period. Long-stay national visa (D) is required."}}

questionText: What is the expiration date indicated on your current passport bio-data page?
helpText: Enter date in YYYY-MM-DD format as printed on your passport.

questionText: What is the issuance date of your current passport?
helpText: Under EU Visa Code Article 12, passports must have been issued within the previous 10 years.

questionText: Have you ever had a visa application refused by the destination country or Schengen member state?
helpText: Full transparency is required on official visa applications. Declaring a refusal does not disqualify you but requires official documentation.
flagTriggerRule: {"field":"value","operator":"equals","operand":"true","flag":{"code":"FLAG_PRIOR_REFUSAL","severity":"WARNING","message":"Applicant reported previous visa refusal. Official consular refusal notice and explanation letter must be submitted for CSR review."}}

questionText: What is your primary commercial activity in the United States?
helpText: B-1 covers consultations, commercial negotiations, and conferences. U.S. domestic employment requires an H-1B or L-1 petition.
